001package pkg_entities;
002
003import java.util.HashMap;
004
005/**
006 * Stores a private collection of trainers keyed by name.
007 *
008 * <p>The internal collection is fully encapsulated and cannot be manipulated directly from outside
009 * this class.
010 *
011 * @author Barnabe Jouanard
012 * @version 2026.04.13
013 */
014public class TrainerList {
015    /** Internal storage keyed by trainer name. */
016    private HashMap<String, Trainer> aTrainers;
017
018    /** Creates an empty trainer list. */
019    public TrainerList() {
020        this.aTrainers = new HashMap<String, Trainer>();
021    } // TrainerList()
022
023    /**
024     * Adds or replaces a trainer under the given key.
025     *
026     * @param pName short identifier used for later retrieval
027     * @param pTrainer the {@link Trainer} to store
028     */
029    public void addTrainer(final String pName, final Trainer pTrainer) {
030        this.aTrainers.put(pName, pTrainer);
031    } // addTrainer()
032
033    /**
034     * Removes the trainer associated with the given key.
035     *
036     * @param pName the lookup key
037     */
038    public void removeTrainer(final String pName) {
039        this.aTrainers.remove(pName);
040    } // removeTrainer()
041
042    /**
043     * Returns the backing trainer map.
044     *
045     * @return trainer names mapped to trainer objects
046     */
047    public HashMap<String, Trainer> getAllTrainers() {
048        return this.aTrainers;
049    } // getAllTrainers()
050
051    /**
052     * Checks whether this trainer list contains no elements.
053     *
054     * @return {@code true} when no trainers are stored
055     */
056    public boolean isEmpty() {
057        return this.aTrainers.isEmpty();
058    } // isEmpty()
059
060    /**
061     * Builds a multi-line string with each trainer's description, or a default notice when the list
062     * is empty.
063     *
064     * @return formatted trainer descriptions
065     */
066    public String getTrainersDescription() {
067        if (this.aTrainers.isEmpty()) {
068            return "There are no trainers here!";
069        }
070        String vResult = "";
071        for (String vName : this.aTrainers.keySet()) {
072            vResult += "There is " + vName + ", " + this.aTrainers.get(vName).getTrainerDescription() + "\n";
073        }
074        return vResult;
075    } // getTrainersDescription()
076} // TrainerList
